measures.name: How low the ball dips
measures.description: How far the shooting wrist drops below the shoulder at its lowest point before the shot starts upward, as a share of body height. Bigger = a deeper dip.
measures.if_below: Dip the ball lower

measures.name: Time from dip to release
measures.description: Seconds from the ball's lowest point to the moment it leaves the hand. Shorter = a quicker shot.
measures.if_below: Slow the lift from the dip
measures.if_above: Get from dip to release faster

measures.name: Knee bend depth
measures.description: The knee angle at the deepest point of the load, averaged over both legs. 180 is a straight leg, so a smaller number means a deeper bend.
measures.if_below: Bend your knees less

measures.name: Time from deepest knee bend to release
measures.description: Seconds from the bottom of the knee bend to the release. Shorter = the legs and the release are closer together.
measures.if_below: Start your leg drive earlier
measures.if_above: Release sooner after the knee bend

measures.name: Elbow fold at the set point
measures.description: The shooting elbow's angle when it is most folded on the way up. 180 is a straight arm, so a smaller number means a tighter, more compact set.
measures.if_below: Open your elbow more at the set
measures.if_above: Fold your elbow tighter at the set

measures.name: Elbow straightness at release
measures.description: The shooting elbow's angle at the moment of release. 180 is fully straight.
measures.if_below: Finish with a straighter elbow

measures.name: Upper-arm height at release
measures.description: How far the shooting upper arm is raised at release, measured from hanging straight down (0) to pointing straight up (180).
measures.if_below: Raise your upper arm at release
measures.if_above: Lower your upper arm at release

measures.name: Body tilt at release
measures.description: How far the trunk is from vertical at release, in any direction. 0 = perfectly upright.
measures.if_below: Allow a little more trunk lean

measures.name: Lift at release
measures.description: How far the hips have risen from their starting height when the ball leaves, as a share of body height. Combines straightening the legs and jumping.
measures.if_below: Get more lift before release

measures.name: Release timing vs top of jump
measures.description: Seconds between the release and the highest point of the jump. Positive = released on the way up; negative = released after the top.
measures.if_below: Release earlier, on the way up

measures.name: Stance width
measures.description: Distance between the ankles at the bottom of the knee bend, as a share of body height.
measures.if_below: Widen your stance

measures.name: Guide-hand separation at release
measures.description: Distance between the two wrists at release, as a share of body height. Bigger = the guide hand has come further off the ball.
measures.if_below: Let the guide hand come off wider

measures.name: Set point distance in front of the head
measures.description: How far in front of the head the shooting wrist sits at the set point, as a share of body height. Relies on estimated depth.
measures.if_below: Set the ball further in front
measures.if_above: Set the ball closer to your head

measures.name: Upper-arm height at the set point
measures.description: How far the shooting upper arm is raised at the set point (0 = hanging down, 90 = horizontal). Higher = the ball is set higher.
measures.if_below: Set the ball higher

measures.name: Arm lift speed
measures.description: The fastest rate at which the shooting upper arm rises, in degrees per second.
measures.if_below: Lift your arm faster

measures.name: Forearm tilt at release
measures.description: How far the shooting forearm is from pointing straight up at release. 0 = vertical; bigger = pointing more forward.
measures.if_below: Tilt your forearm more forward

measures.name: Leg straightness at release
measures.description: Knee angle at the moment of release. 180 is straight, so a smaller number means the legs are still bent when the ball leaves.
measures.if_below: Straighten your legs more by release

measures.name: Hip straightness at release
measures.description: Trunk-to-thigh angle at release. 180 is fully extended.
measures.if_below: Extend your hips more by release

measures.name: Leg drive speed
measures.description: The fastest rate at which the knees straighten on the way up, in degrees per second.
measures.if_below: Drive up through your legs faster
measures.if_above: Drive up through your legs smoother

measures.name: Delay between leg drive and arm snap
measures.description: Seconds from the legs' fastest straightening to the elbow's fastest opening. Bigger = the arm fires later after the legs; 0 = both at once.
measures.if_below: Fire the arm later after the legs
measures.if_above: Fire the arm sooner after the legs

measures.name: Left-right knee difference
measures.description: Difference between the left and right knee angles at the bottom of the bend. 0 = both knees bent the same.
measures.if_below: Load one leg a bit more

measures.name: Foot stagger
measures.description: How far the shooting-side foot is in front of the other foot, as a share of body height. Relies on estimated depth.
measures.if_below: Put your shooting foot further ahead

measures.name: Forward lean in the load
measures.description: How far the chest leans forward at the bottom of the knee bend. Negative = leaning back.
measures.if_below: Lean forward more in the load
measures.if_above: Stay more upright in the load

measures.name: Forward or backward lean at release
measures.description: Trunk lean at release with direction: positive = leaning forward, negative = fading back.
measures.if_below: Finish more forward

measures.name: Shoulder turn relative to hips at release
measures.description: Seen from above, the angle between the shoulder line and the hip line at release. 0 = square. Relies on estimated depth.
measures.if_below: Turn your shoulders more than your hips
measures.if_above: Keep shoulders square to your hips

measures.name: Body rotation during the shot
measures.description: How many degrees the hips rotate between the load and just after release. Relies on estimated depth.
measures.if_below: Turn your body more through the shot
measures.if_above: Turn your body less through the shot

measures.name: Head movement
measures.description: The largest horizontal movement of the head relative to the hips before release, as a share of body height. Smaller = a stiller head.
measures.if_below: Let your head move with the shot

measures.name: Shot fluidity (one-motion vs two-motion)
measures.description: How much the ball keeps moving upward as it passes the set point: its upward speed there divided by its top speed. Near 1 = one continuous motion; near 0 = a clear pause before the push (two-motion).
measures.if_below: Keep the ball moving through the set
measures.if_above: Add a slight pause at the set

measures.name: Ball travel from dip to release
measures.description: Total distance the shooting wrist travels from the dip to the release, as a share of body height. Bigger = a longer, loopier path.
measures.if_below: Lengthen the ball path

measures.name: Hand spacing at the set point
measures.description: Distance between the two wrists at the set point, as a share of body height.
measures.if_below: Spread your hands wider on the ball
measures.if_above: Bring your hands closer on the ball

measures.name: Follow-through hold
measures.description: How much the shooting wrist rises or falls in the 0.3 seconds after release, as a share of body height. Near 0 or positive = the arm stays up; negative = it drops.
measures.if_below: Hold your follow-through
measures.if_above: Relax your arm sooner after release

measures.name: Wrist bend at release
measures.description: Angle between forearm and hand at release. 180 = straight wrist; smaller = more bent. Uses estimated fingertip depth.
measures.if_below: Keep your wrist straighter at release
measures.if_above: Cock your wrist more at release

measures.name: Wrist snap after release
measures.description: How many degrees the hand folds forward in the 0.13 seconds after release. Uses estimated fingertip depth.
measures.if_below: Snap your wrist more

measures.name: Shooting-foot angle
measures.description: How far the shooting-side foot is turned from pointing straight ahead (positive = turned outward). Relies on estimated depth.
measures.if_below: Turn your shooting foot out more
